g.text: Measured driving video • Highest observed bitrate first • T340 highlighted
All 16 cameras with measured primary-front 3840×2160 / 30 fps data in this library. Audio excluded.
Ranges use the upper end for ordering; dark marks show the range. Unknown quality settings are not “Maximum.”
Codecs, HDR, scenes and camera configurations differ. Higher bitrate alone does not establish better image quality.
